claim_boundary: This source manifest records configured test intent only. CONFIGURED_UNRUN is not execution evidence or a support claim. A component remains unestablished on a coordinate until a later exact run emits bounded evidence for the catalog and manifest digests named by that run.

status_vocabulary.CONFIGURED_UNRUN: The repository configures the mapped tests for this coordinate, but this manifest records no execution result.
status_vocabulary.NOT_CONFIGURED: The repository does not currently configure the mapped component contract for this coordinate.
status_vocabulary.UNSUPPORTED: The repository path explicitly does not offer this component contract on this coordinate; this does not characterize upstream capability.
